text: 767 suppresses the original link click with preventDefault and stopPropagation and dispatches ctaclick. Current code uses InAppNotificationEvent to include the notification ID, and the manager handles primary-button CTA activation. This prevents independent link handling from competing with notification bookkeeping. The newer event class and manager behavior are current comparisons, not attributed entirely to 767. Mouse-button and composed-event assertions exist; keyboard and external-navigation behavior were not run.
title: Route notification activation through its custom event and manager
